title: Owner decision needed: separate few-shot request per item or one shared request?
description:
## Decided (owner, 2026-10-01): one request per item

Each item gets **one** Jev request carrying the example list in the state together with every rubric question. The answer cache key includes the list fingerprint, so a list change re-asks the labeled set (a few hundred requests; accepted). This reverses the earlier recommendation of a separate few-shot request.

## The question as asked (Q2)

Should the fixed example list go in its **own few-shot request** per item (2 Jev requests per item, clean caches; the design's choice), or **ride in the same request** as every rubric question?

- One request halves the per-item cost.
- But the examples' labels would influence element answers, and every list change would make every cached element answer stale.

## Definition of done

Answer recorded here; the core `ClassifierBundle` story and the bundle-freeze task follow it. Cost: $0.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §1.2 (Reload and classify), §7 Q2.

## Companion-project coordination

- [Decision-Flywheel](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel/tree/main/project/issues): `decision-flywheel-7284b9aa-7c87-4bd4-b5d3-f7a67546cbdd`.

These are cross-repository references; local Kanbus blocked-by relationships encode prerequisites within this repository.
